target_domain: Yoga Planner / Any Custom Planner HTML Skeleton
instruction_for_ai: You are integrating state management, auto-save, multi-document archiving, export/import, and print rules into a host HTML template. You MUST strictly separate LOGIC from VISUAL STYLING.
strict_rules: RULE 1: DO NOT CHANGE HOST CSS / THEME / COLORS / FONTS. Retain all existing :root variables, background colors, fonts, borders, and visual styles of the host template completely untouched.
RULE 2: DO NOT ALTER HOST CONTENT / EMOJIS / DOMAIN TEXT. Do NOT inject Chibi mascots, Sakura emojis, or Chibi titles. Retain the host template's Yoga theme, poses, Namaste copy, and icons.

RULE 3: BINDING ONLY VIA data-key ATTRIBUTES. Attach data-key='...' attributes to host editable elements (<input>, <textarea>, [contenteditable], checkbox) without altering their HTML layout or class names.
RULE 4: ADD ONLY THE JS LOGIC ENGINE. Inject the 800ms debounced auto-save engine, multi-document activeWeekId tracking, JSON/CSV export/import, and versioning logic in JavaScript.
RULE 5: MINIMAL TOOLBAR ENCRYPTION. Integrate a toolbar that inherits the host page's visual styling variables (--primary, --card, --border) rather than hardcoded Chibi colors.

engine_architecture.export_format_json: Includes appVersion, version=2, exportedAt, activeWeekId, current, archive
engine_architecture.export_format_csv: Includes UTF-8 BOM (\ufeff), metadata header (Document_Name, Exported_At), escaped key-value rows
engine_architecture.print_css_rules: @media print { @page { size: portrait; margin: 8mm; } .page, .daily-page, .yoga-card { break-after: page; page-break-after: always; break-inside: avoid; height: 98vh; max-height: 98vh; overflow: hidden; } }
